تنحنحت (form IIq)
# تَنَحْنَحْتُ (tanaḥnaḥtu) /ta.naħ.naħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَحْنَحَ (tanaḥnaḥa)
# تَنَحْنَحْتَ (tanaḥnaḥta) /ta.naħ.naħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَحْنَحَ (tanaḥnaḥa)
# تَنَحْنَحْتِ (tanaḥnaḥti) /ta.naħ.naħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَحْنَحَ (tanaḥnaḥa)
# تَنَحْنَحَتْ (tanaḥnaḥat) /ta.naħ.na.ħat/: t
